mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.parent_id, d.head_id, d.is_active, p.name as parentName, e.name as headName FROM DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT p ON d.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON d.head_id = e.id ORDER BY d.id
SELECT * FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEPARTMENT (name, parent_id, head_id, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{headId}, #{isActive})
